P2300.title: Ignition Coil A Primary Control Circuit Low
P2300.description: The primary control circuit of ignition coil A reads a voltage below the expected level — usually a short to ground on the primary driver wire or a low-resistance fault in the coil primary winding. Coil A cannot build a normal charge, so the cylinder it fires misfires, especially under load. Causes: short to ground in the primary wiring, an internal coil primary fault, or a faulty ECU/igniter driver.

causes.label: Internal coil short
Primary wire shorted to ground
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

P2301.title: Ignition Coil A Primary Control Circuit High

The ECU sees no normal current flow, coil A does not fire, and the cylinder misfires. Causes: an open or disconnected primary wire, an internal open in the coil, or a faulty ECU driver.

causes.label: Primary wire shorted to battery
Open primary winding
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

P2302.title: Ignition Coil A Secondary Circuit
